description: This file is a shell script used as a build and test automation workflow for the entservices-appgateway-34 project. It performs setup, cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring builds with CMake, building dependencies like googletest, building the main application and tests, running unit tests, collecting coverage data, and generating reports.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Function to print informational messages with a prefix.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Function to print warning messages to stderr.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Function to print error messages to stderr.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if the system can run apt-get commands (i.e., running as root or sudo available).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Wrapper around apt-get to run non-interactively with specific options.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails, but does not abort the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git commands.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref (tag/branch) in a repository, fetching if necessary.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if missing and checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory idempotently.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project with optional extra arguments.
